## Objective
- Finish the existing TG BOXING game and verify it is playable.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save a JPEG no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Installed project dependencies with `npm ci`.

### Active
- Build, inspect, and verify the existing game; make any needed fixes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `npm run build` and inspect/fix any build errors.
2. Run the game and verify the main flow and a playable fight; capture and inspect a screenshot if useful.
3. Summarize changes, verification, and any assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: application boot and screen registration.
- `src/ui/screens/create.js`: career creation flow.
- `src/ui/screens/fight.js`: fight UI, controls, and game lifecycle.
- `src/game/fight.js`: boxing simulation.
- `src/app.js`: Three.js renderer, environments, and animation loop.
- `package.json`: build and test commands.

## Important Context
- `npm test` completed successfully but found zero tests.
- Before `npm ci`, `npm run build` failed with `sh: 1: vite: not found`; dependencies are now installed.
- `npm ci` reported 2 audit vulnerabilities (1 moderate, 1 high).
- No implementation changes have been made yet.
